scope: Six lifted RPG.GameCore.ModifyActionDelay payloads with exactly fixed AddNormalizedValue and an explicit target alias.
selected_model: Resolve each target in deterministic target-alias order, apply the scheduler reference ActionDelayState.add(delta) transition per target, and clamp the normalized value at zero. ordering: Targets are resolved in canonical TargetAlias order. Each target commits its add-and-clamp transition synchronously; no AV reorder or action-completion side effect is inferred at this packet boundary.
